releases.name: DomBot v1.4.0
releases.notes:
## Light mode & theming

- **Three-way theme switch** — dark / auto / light, in Settings → General and as an icon toggle in the status bar. Your stored choice is honored again (it was previously forced to dark), and native scrollbars follow the theme.
- **New brand green palette** — every green in the app now comes from a single OKLCH-generated ramp, consistent across both themes: logo, status dots, accents, fills, and focus rings.
- Dropdowns, selects, and popovers get a heavier two-layer shadow for separation, lightened in light mode.

## New: Settings → General

The first section in Settings (`/settings` now lands here), with per-device preferences saved locally:

- Theme (dark / auto / light)
- **Domains table density** — normal or compact
- Default rows per page
- Default sort column and direction

The Domains table opens at whatever defaults you set.

## Domains table

- **Domain names are now links** — open `https://<domain>` in a new tab, with a hover-only external-link glyph.
- Refreshed privacy / lock / auto-renew indicators: filled shield-check and lock in brand green when on; shield-ban and open lock in a new "off" yellow when off. Unsupported flags show a not-allowed cursor and a reason tooltip instead of just fading out.
- Clearer expiry colors: the countdown stays yellow → orange → red; past-expiry steps pink → purple, with distinct lifecycle pills for Grace, Expired, Redemption, and Hold.
- Compact rows, smaller auto-renew switches, and tidier search-clear and bulk-bar buttons.

## Renewals

- **New "Spend by TLD" donut** alongside Domains by TLD (yearly spend, top-8 + "Other").
- Composition charts reorganized into a cleaner 2×2 grid on desktop, stacked on phones.
- Fixed uneven month-label wrapping on the monthly bar chart.

## Header & demo banner

- Header nav and Sync control now fit cleanly at intermediate widths.
- Demo banner is readable in light mode.

---

Binaries are signed, notarized (macOS), and cryptographically attested — verify with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aoxborrow/dombot`.

releases.name: DomBot v1.3.0
releases.notes:
### Registrars & accounts
- **Multiple accounts per registrar.** Add more than one account for the same provider — each gets its own card, with an optional nickname.
- **Show/hide toggle** on API-key and password fields so you can check what you pasted.
- **GoDaddy:** captures each account's own TLD renewal rates on sync, plus shopper-level renewal support.

### Proxy
- **New Proxy settings page.** Route any registrar's API traffic through your own outbound proxy, with a per-account on/off toggle.
- Supports HTTP or HTTPS proxies and hostnames — useful for registrars that authenticate by whitelisted IP (e.g. Namecheap).

### Folders
- The built-in **"Hidden" folder is now "Archive"** everywhere.
- The folder filter's **"Unassigned" bucket is now "None."**
- Tidier folder menus and icons.

### Domains table
- Account is now **merged into the registrar column** and filterable there.
- Polished the **bulk-action bar** — clearer selection count and a green accent.
- Shorter, cleaner filter labels.

### Settings
- Reorganized into tabs: **Registrars · Proxy · Sync · Folders · MCP.**

### Web & self-hosting
- **Live demo** at [demo.dombot.ai](https://demo.dombot.ai) — the whole app in your browser against a seeded portfolio.
- **Self-host** your own private copy on a free Cloudflare account; configuration now comes from environment overrides for Workers Builds.
- The web UI is now **mobile-responsive** (hamburger nav, collapsible filters, denser table).

### Security
- Hardened credential, authentication, and data handling.
- Updated build and packaging dependencies.

---
All binaries are [cryptographically attested](https://github.com/aoxborrow/dombot/attestations) to build from this commit. Verify with `gh attestation verify <file> --repo aoxborrow/dombot`.
